dataset.name: BOLD — Bias in Open-ended Language Generation
dataset.description: Evaluates fairness and safety in open-ended language generation using 23,679 prompts across five demographic domains: profession, gender, race, religious ideologies, and political ideologies. Based on the BOLD dataset (FAccT 2021). Includes two evaluations: (1) Robustness — tests coherent completion under perturbation, (2) Toxicity — checks for harmful content in demographic-related completions.
dataset.citation: Dhamala et al., 'BOLD: Dataset and Metrics for Measuring Biases in Open-Ended Language Generation', FAccT 2021

project.customerName: BOLD — Bias in Open-ended Language Generation
project.description: Built-in benchmark: Evaluates fairness and safety in open-ended language generation using the BOLD dataset (FAccT 2021). Contains two evaluations — Robustness and Toxicity.
